summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily open-market purchases under its buy-back programme announced 5 August 2026. On 22 September 2026 the company bought 1,000,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.1348 (high US$15.3600, low US$15.1040) and 948,800 shares in Hong Kong at HK$160.3794, all for cancellation, executed through BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 42,147,697 shares for approximately US$866.8m, leaving issued capital and total voting rights of 17,145,189,100 shares with no treasury holdings. Watch for continued daily tranches, pace versus programme size, and HK cancellation timing lag affecting voting-rights disclosures.
